name: Physical Release Guard
description: Automatically manages a configurable tag for movies and series based on TMDb physical release data.
overview: Scans your movie and series libraries and adds or removes a configurable tag based on whether a physical release exists according to TMDb data. Movies use TMDb physical release dates; series use TMDb DVD/physical episode-group evidence.

versions.changelog: Jellyfin 12.1 support. Rebuilt against Jellyfin 12.1.0 on .NET 10 (targetAbi 12.1.0.0); requires Jellyfin 12.1 or newer (Jellyfin 10.11 users should stay on v1.12.0.0). Includes all v1.12.0 scan quality-of-life improvements. Also fixes the config page's Scan Schedule hour, which was silently ignored because it posted to a non-existent task-trigger route using the task Key instead of the task id.

Quality-of-life release: live per-library scan progress and cancellation, scan-all-enabled, TMDb connection test, bulk library and title-exclusion controls, configurable metadata settle delay for auto-scan, save-and-apply manual TMDb links, correct unmatched cleanup, and exclusion handling for single-library scans.

Fixes UNIQUE constraint failure when applying the auto-block tag for new users in Parental Control. The plugin now merges tags into the existing PreferenceKind.BlockedTags row (using Jellyfin's pipe-separated format) instead of inserting a duplicate row that violates the (UserId, Kind) UNIQUE index.

Performance & reliability improvements: polite TMDb client (configurable rate limit, retries with exponential backoff + jitter), bounded-parallel scans, optional per-scan circuit breaker, persistent Unmatched TMDb Items panel on the config page with per-item retry and manual TMDb ID pinning.
Auto-block tag for new users in Parental Control. Adds Parental Control section with toggle and apply-to-all-users button.
Adds configurable scan schedule UI, dry-run mode for previewing changes, and preferred region filtering for TMDb physical releases.
Prevents concurrent library scans. Scan Now buttons disable while a scan is running and re-enable when it completes.
Adds configurable movie and series exclusions so selected titles are skipped and left untouched by the Hidden tag scan.
